Culture Amp named Sequoia Capital China as lead. The Nasdaq syndication of the company’s Business Wire release is timestamped 3 September 2019 at 10:00 a.m. EDT, which was 4 September in Melbourne. The company’s release carries the 4 September 2019 Melbourne dateline and its web page displays 4 September 2020. The legal close date remains unknown.

The issuer named Blackbird Ventures as lead and Felicis Ventures, Index Ventures, Sapphire Ventures, Skip Capital, Grok Ventures and Hostplus as participants. The issuer page labels July 19, 2018 as updated. Index Ventures published its confirmation of the round and its participation that day, supporting the announcement date. The legal close date remains unknown.

On March 4, 2015, Culture Amp announced that the round had closed. Its release named Felicis Ventures, Index Ventures and Blackbird Ventures as leads. TechCrunch described Felicis as lead and Index and Blackbird as participants. The CEO’s later account emphasized Felicis and named the other two as investors. SmartCompany’s March 4 interview coverage gives the denomination in US dollars. The issuer release uses an unqualified dollar sign. The exact close date and valuation remain unknown.

Culture Amp announced on March 7, 2016 that its Series B had closed. The issuer named Index Ventures as lead and Felicis Ventures and Blackbird Ventures as participants. The exact close date is unknown. Startup Daily's March 11, 2016 report and SmartCompany's March 8, 2016 coverage identify the currency as USD. The issuer uses an unqualified dollar sign.

Culture Amp announced the Series C at HR Tech World in San Francisco on June 14, 2017 local time. The issuer wire published June 15 at 07:00 ET reports the previous day's announcement and names Sapphire Ventures as lead, with Index Ventures, Felicis Ventures and Blackbird Ventures participating. Didier Elzinga's June 23 account and lead-investor counsel Bird & Bird specify US$20 million. The exact legal close date is unknown.
